title: On a phone the representative fields look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is a phone screen 390 px wide, and the design pictures "phone-02-n6-field.png" (board 6.2), "phone-03-n6-list.png" (board 6.3), "phone-04-n6-picked.png" (board 6.4), "phone-05-n6-add-menu.png" (board 6.5), "phone-06-n6-added.png" (board 6.6) and "phone-07-n6-parts-list.png" (board 6.7) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer), card expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the field with the picture of board 6.2.
  2. Tap the field and compare with the picture of board 6.3.
  3. Pick {Sales-rep-A} and compare with the picture of board 6.4.
  4. Tap the + and compare with the picture of board 6.5.
  5. Add Parts and compare with the picture of board 6.6.
  6. Tap "Sales Representative - Parts" and compare with the picture of board 6.7.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative" reading "Unassigned", with the + (32 px) always showing beside it and the dropdown arrow shown.
  • Step 2: the native dropdown, the same as Lead Technician: "Unassigned" first, then the representatives.
  • Step 3: {Sales-rep-A}; the + shows without any hover.
  • Step 4: the menu "Sales Representative - Parts".
  • Step 5: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both {Sales-rep-A}, labels in full; the remove x (32 px) always showing beside Parts; each field shows its arrow.
  • Step 6: the same list per row.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R1, S3-R2, S3-R4, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 6.2 The field on a phone; 6.3 Tap: the list; 6.4 One rep picked; 6.5 Tap the +; 6.6 Parts added; 6.7 Parts list on a phone (the attached pictures are these boards). Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design shows no dropdown arrow at rest on a phone (boards 6.2 and 6.6: "At rest the rows read as plain text."). The PRD says the arrow always shows on a touch screen; this case follows the PRD, and the difference is on the product owner's question sheet.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R1: “Tapping a Sales Representative field opens the same dropdown Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone, with the same options as on a desktop (S1-R8, S1-R9).”
  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”

  • Design — board 6.5 title: “6.5 Tap the +”
